title: Bandgap-Engineered In2S3 Quantum Dots Anchored on Oxygen-Doped g-C3N4: Forging a Dynamic n-n Heterojunction for Enhanced Persulfate Activation and Degradation of Metronidazole
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00859F, Paper
Soumya Ranjan Mishra, Vishal Gadore, Saptarshi Roy, Md. Ahmaruzzaman
Herein, an ultrasonication approach was used to anchor In2S3 quantum dots (QDs) onto oxygen-doped graphitic carbon nitride (O@g-C3N4), resulting in a novel heterojunction catalyst. Characterization techniques validated the successful incorporation...
